attribution.note: Marcus states these views in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves all three clauses and their hedges. Observation correctly describes the firm China clause; the Russia and US clauses are unscorable speculation.

contract.note: Reading Party-line conformity as mandatory ideological restrictions on public generative AI services is ordinary and fair in context. The contract appropriately excludes the hedged clauses.

evidence.note: The official final regulation establishes mandatory ideological requirements for public generative AI services, effective August 15, 2023. Article 2 excludes nonpublic development and applications.
The translation corroborates the mandatory socialist-values requirement and prohibited content. It translates the same regulation rather than providing independent corroboration.
Reporting on regulatory testing in July 2024 provides enforcement context. Under the contract, news reporting does not establish the binding legal requirement.

reviews.rationale: The final CAC measures impose ideological requirements on public generative AI services and took effect before Marcus's post. Their scope fits the ordinary contextual reading. The packet contains no evidence of withdrawal, though later amendments were not checked. Support applies only to the firm China observation; the hedged Russia and US clauses are not adjudicable.
